permissionDenied.behavior: Blocked or ASK_USER. Cannot auto retry same Tool.
permissionDenied.boundary: B32将permission_denied归入BLOCKED或ASK_USER。重入Decision时candidate需要permission导向到替代能力。

scopeDenied.behavior: Blocked. Cannot bypass via path change.

runtimeUnavailable.behavior: WAIT or alternate capability. No busy loop.

dependencyMissing.behavior: WAIT or alternate. No busy loop.
